topics.label: Introduction and overview of cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the lecture framework, learning objectives, and historical model of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Growth signaling pathways and proliferative independence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how oncogenic mutations across cell-surface receptors and intracellular cascades drive self-sufficient proliferation and override growth inhibition.

topics.label: Block to terminal differentiation in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how failure to complete lineage differentiation sustains abnormal progenitor expansion in leukemias and carcinomas.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis and cell death evasion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through disruptions in p53 transactivation and Bcl-2 family mitochondrial regulation.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, senescence, and telomere maintenance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cells respond to critical telomere shortening and how cancer cells bypass senescence via telomerase upregulation and stress checkpoint evasion.

topics.label: Complex hallmarks and cancer metabolic rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics transition to complex hallmarks and describe how cancer cells reprogram core metabolic pathways to support rapid biosynthesis.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how developing neoplasms activate new blood vessel formation to overcome diffusion limits for oxygen and nutrients.

topics.label: Mechanisms, barriers, and genetics of tumor metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the anatomical routes, clinical monitoring, biological inefficiencies, and clonal genomics involved in metastatic cancer spread.

topics.label: Summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics provide the concluding lecture framing by summarizing the collective nature of cancer hallmarks and closing the session.
